source_snapshot.procedure: Press F3 in BIOS Setup to return settings to default values.
source_snapshot.criteria: The function key should work properly.
source_snapshot.script: No script. Five minutes attended and five machine minutes.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO because the Optimized Defaults/F3 action is interactive in pre-OS BIOS Setup and cannot be performed over ordinary SSH.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY with vendor default definition, complete configuration baseline, explicit apply/save/reboot boundary and tested restoration/recovery.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Correct for this row but the same code also names the unrelated console-redirection variant.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains MANUAL ONLY and adds broad configuration, approval, evidence and recovery controls.
historical_reviews.history: Sequence 554 is the distinct row-377 console-redirection case; its COM matrix does not apply to Optimized Defaults.
historical_reviews.v3_1: The F3 response must be separated from actually applying/saving defaults and verified against the platform's approved default set.

original_test_intent: Verify that F3 in the identified BIOS Setup context invokes the documented Optimized Defaults behavior and presents or applies the correct platform default values without uncontrolled persistence.
original_method: Bind the exact row/variant and platform default reference, capture the complete current configuration, enter Setup through an approved console, press F3 once, capture the response/default preview, and apply/save/reboot or restore only under explicit approval.
manual_activity: A human operator must verify the correct Setup context, press F3 once, visually assess the defaults response and control any apply/save/reboot and restoration; this is not the duplicate serial-console matrix.
required_inputs: Platform-approved Optimized Defaults definition and expected values
Validated physical or remote pre-OS input/capture path
Approved apply/save/reboot and tested restore/recovery procedure
safety_requirements: Do not apply/save/reboot without explicit approval
Stop on ambiguous or unexpected defaults
No automatic retry or hardware PASS claim
agent_execution_scope: Verify row/variant, platform default reference and supplied baseline
Prepare the expected-value and configuration-diff checklist
Report without claiming the manual key action or final verdict
engineer_actions: Approve the default definition, persistence scope and recovery

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly states ordinary SSH cannot press F3 or prove the BIOS Setup defaults response; code-only use would be unsafe because row 377 has a different purpose.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain one operator-driven F3 interaction on the pinned platform context, compare the response with the approved default definition, and keep preview separate from persistence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: F3, Optimized Defaults and 5/5-minute timing are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture and diff the complete baseline, F3 defaults preview/response, any approved applied state and final restored/accepted configuration in one timestamped sequence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds variant binding, platform-default oracle and explicit preview-versus-persistence boundaries.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; console-redirection coverage is explicitly excluded.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Firmware may alter many hidden or dependent settings and F3 semantics can be platform/build specific.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve keeping the default state instead of restoring baseline, but must document the exact accepted configuration and must not import the duplicate row-377 COM matrix.
expected_evidence: Platform default reference and complete pre-action configuration
Configuration diff and explicit apply/save/reboot state
Restored baseline or owner-accepted final state and normal recovery

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Row 1476 consistently defines Optimized Defaults; duplicate row 377 is isolated by row/hash/variant and its console-redirection procedure remains separate.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The manual defaults purpose is clear; the vendor definition, baseline, operator, approval and recovery are finite project inputs rather than an irreducible blocker.

review_improvement: Prevents duplicate-code contamination and turns a generic F3 response into a platform-referenced, diffable and recoverable full-configuration action.
independent_technical_reasoning: Optimized Defaults can broadly change boot-critical configuration and requires contextual human observation and control of persistence. Automation may compare exported evidence but cannot safely replace the F3 interaction; MANUAL ONLY remains correct.
